lesson: Inverse-volatility weighting on BM+ESBR value-earnings synergy strategy degraded all metrics vs EW base (SR 0.826 vs 0.857, MDD 37.8% vs 34.3%, CAGR 12.1% vs 13.4%). The ivol method concentrates into low-vol names which may conflict with the value signal's natural bias toward higher-vol cheap stocks. Naming mismatch (ICWeight vs ivol) should be corrected. For Asness et al (2015) style value+quality combinations, equal weighting preserves the signal better than inverse-vol. True IC-weighting (allocating more to factors with higher recent trailing IC) remains untested and could be a distinct S5 mutation. OOS retention 45% and IC decay (0.52 ratio) suggest the alpha source is modest but real.
